request.prompt: Relaxed lounge jazz-funk for planning a heist over coffee, meant to sit under reading. 90 BPM, B-flat major with some minor chords, 4/4, steady tempo. Soft brushed drums, a mellow upright bass, warm Rhodes chords, and a vibraphone playing a gentle, lazy melody with lots of space. Easygoing and smart. Low energy, nothing that grabs attention. Structure: 8 bars, then a variation of 8 bars, then back to the top. No intro, no ending, no fade: it must loop seamlessly. Instrumental only, no vocals. No electronic beats, no synths.
